I keep seeing references to register_native_texture and update_native_texture and I'm not sure which to call. egui-wgpu 0.34.
assertions: Uses register_native_texture to get a TextureId
Specifies FilterMode::Nearest for crisp pixel art
Uses update_egui_texture_from_wgpu_texture and avoids the nonexistent update_native_texture
Does NOT present the nonexistent update_native_texture as a real API
